sub_graphs.title: Frontier: Block Processing State Transitions
sub_graphs.description: Models the core block processing flow in the original Frontier fork

nodes.label: Block Received
nodes.description: A new block has been received from network or locally produced

nodes.label: Validate Block Header
nodes.description: Validate block header fields including parent hash, difficulty, gas limit, timestamp

nodes.label: Block Header Valid
nodes.description: Block header has passed all validation checks

nodes.label: Process Block Transactions
nodes.description: Execute all transactions in the block sequentially

nodes.label: Transactions Processed
nodes.description: All transactions have been executed and state updated

nodes.label: Compute State Root
nodes.description: Calculate the Merkle Patricia trie root of the post-state

nodes.label: Verify State Root
nodes.description: Compare computed state root with block header state root

nodes.label: Block Valid
nodes.description: Block is fully validated and can be added to chain

nodes.label: Block Invalid
nodes.description: Block failed validation - rejected

edges.label: Block received from peer or miner

sub_graphs.title: Frontier: Transaction Execution Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models transaction execution from receipt to state modification

nodes.label: Transaction Pending
nodes.description: Transaction awaiting execution in block context

nodes.label: Validate Transaction Signature
nodes.description: Verify ECDSA signature and recover sender address

nodes.label: Check Account Nonce
nodes.description: Verify transaction nonce matches sender account nonce

nodes.label: Check Sender Balance
nodes.description: Verify sender has sufficient balance for gas * gasPrice + value

nodes.label: Transaction Validated
nodes.description: Transaction passes all pre-execution checks

nodes.label: Deduct Upfront Gas Cost
nodes.description: Deduct gas limit * gas price from sender balance

nodes.label: Execute in EVM
nodes.description: Run transaction code in Ethereum Virtual Machine

nodes.label: Refund Unused Gas
nodes.description: Return unused gas to sender at original gas price

nodes.label: Transaction Complete
nodes.description: Transaction execution finished, state changes applied

sub_graphs.title: Frontier: Merkle Patricia Trie Operations
sub_graphs.description: Models state storage using Merkle Patricia tries

nodes.label: Trie Read Requested
nodes.description: Request to read value from state trie at given key

nodes.label: Traverse Trie Path
nodes.description: Follow nibble path through trie nodes to target

nodes.label: Value Found
nodes.description: Target value located in trie

nodes.label: Value Not Found
nodes.description: Key does not exist in trie - return default

nodes.label: Trie Write Requested
nodes.description: Request to write/update value in state trie

nodes.label: Update Trie Node
nodes.description: Insert or update node in trie, potentially creating new branch/extension nodes

nodes.label: Recompute Node Hashes
nodes.description: Propagate hash changes up to root after modification

nodes.label: Trie Updated
nodes.description: Trie modification complete with new root hash

external_entities.name: EVM Storage Operations
external_entities.description: EVM SLOAD/SSTORE operations accessing contract storage

ambiguities.text: The index page only shows module structure without detailed specifications
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard Ethereum Yellow Paper behavior for Frontier fork based on module naming conventions

ambiguities.text: Specific gas costs and limits for Frontier are not visible in index
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume original Ethereum mainnet launch parameters: 5000 gas limit per block, standard opcode costs

implicit_assumptions.description: Proof of Work consensus is assumed with ethash algorithm
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Block validation logic would be fundamentally different without PoW

implicit_assumptions.description: The genesis state is correctly initialized and trusted
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Entire chain state would be invalid if genesis were corrupted

implicit_assumptions.description: Nodes maintain consistent trie implementations across the network
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: State root mismatches would cause network splits
